parsed.why: Same-sex conduct lawful, no trans-specific offence or state harassment; but individual harassment common, police occasionally use modesty charges against gender-nonconforming people, and no GI protections. Elevated social exposure.

Same-sex conduct criminalised up to seven years and applied to foreigners; state hostility, no LGBTQ organising, abusive detention. No trans-specific statute or border practice documented, but outed trans visitor risks arrest as homosexual/gender-nonconforming.

Strong anti-discrimination and self-ID, X passports, no criminalisation. Deductions for recurring hate speech/differential treatment, GI omitted from hate-crime law, and court-approved male-prison placement for trans inmates; single murder weak pattern.

Active enforcement against gender presentation: trans women sentenced to five years for women's clothing, appearance-based arrests, police beatings/extortion and abusive prisons. Criminalisation plus state-tolerated violence makes outing catastrophic.

Explicit cross-dressing offence enforced, same-sex criminalisation, deportation and surveillance; documented border detention/strip/touch of genderqueer visitor. Slightly above D4 only because recent enforcement record stops 2020 and penalties lower.
